siteManifest.verify:
cosign verify-blob \
  --bundle site.sha256.sigstore.json \
  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/bounded-systems/site/' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  site.sha256
# then check the live bytes against the signed manifest:
sha256sum -c site.sha256

caveat: Provenance proves who built this site and that it is intact — not that the build was safe or authorized. Identity and integrity, not legitimacy. https://bounded.tools/blog/provenance-is-not-legitimacy
